profile.name: Guru Kannan
profile.summary: Java Developer looking for new opportunities | Founder at Ednue Technologies

about.summary: Hi, I’m Guru Kannan – Java whisperer by day, tech mentor by passion. Currently building scalable backend systems at TCS, and shaping tomorrow’s tech talent through my upskilling venture Ednue Technologies. Previously at Neurealm, I juggled Perl scripts and Java microservices like a backend ninja.

responsibilities: Designing Trade Processors and systems for Citi Bank.
Developing scalable backend microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
Implemented REST APIs and handled data persistence with Hibernate.
Played a pivotal role in the ABCD Aditya Birla Capital Digital (UPI Payments) project.
Developed Wrapper microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
Utilized Git for version control, Grafana for monitoring, and Firebase for backend services.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams for seamless integration.
Writing technical articles and content about web development and random tech hobbies.
Skills: Web Content Creation, Web Development.
Contributed to the Athenahealth Rules 2.0 Migration project.
Developed and implemented Perl scripts utilizing RedHat DMN and aNet architecture.
Troubleshoot and debugged migration processes in a Linux environment.

awards.title: STAR Performer of the Quarter
awards.description: Awarded the STAR Performer of the Quarter for Q1 (April 2024 – June 2024) by GAVS Technologies in recognition of my unwavering dedication and outstanding contributions to the organization.

awards.title: ABCD Edge Award
awards.description: Received the ABCD Edge Award from our esteemed client, Aditya Birla Capital, in recognition of my contributions to the UPI-Lite Auto-Top-up and Delegate Payments projects. This recognition highlights the strong collaboration between Aditya Birla Capital and GAVS Technologies in delivering innovative and impactful solutions.

awards.title: Spot Recognition Award
awards.description: Thrilled to receive the Spot Recognition Award for Going Above & Beyond in unveiling and deploying new features for the ABCD Aditya Birla Capital Digital App at Global Fintech Fest (#GFF2024) last August.

awards.title: Spot Award (Replica of ABCD App)
awards.description: Received the replica for the successful launch of the ABCD Aditya Birla Capital Digital App on Play Store.
